captions.text: Good. I'd be insulted.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: The clone pops. Across the village, Naruto sits up in the dark holding a memory that isn't his. A mask.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A fox who didn't choose. The seal didn't just break. Somebody was there. And that isn't in any file in the Leaf.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Tomorrow, brat. And bring a book with a villain who wins.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: Somebody else has noticed.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Danzo, the Third's oldest rival, hears of a boy with the Nine-Tails, a jutsu that copies his mind, and the keys to the archive.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: To the Third, it's a lonely child with a filing job.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: To Danzo, it's a weapon left unattended in a library.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Two in the morning. A man in a plain white mask walks into the archive.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: No village crest. No footsteps. He heads straight for the Namikaze box.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: By the shelf stands a filing box. It's been there since yesterday.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nobody asked why. It's a clone, and it's having the worst shift of its life.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Do not move. You're a box. Boxes don't have opinions.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: He's reading the Uzumaki file. Why is he reading the Uzumaki file?
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: He's writing in a little book. Boss is gonna want that little book.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: He's counting the boxes. There are forty. I'm number forty one. I don't match.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The Root agent reads for an hour.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then, tired of standing, he does what nobody in the Leaf has ever done to a filing box. He sits on it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. A man is using me as a stool.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Boxes make no noise. This one remembers his hands, his boots and every page he opened.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: When he leaves, the clone pops. The only witness was furniture.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Morning. The Hokage's office. Danzo doesn't knock.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Third doesn't look up from his pipe. Naruto, filing in the corner, does.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hiruzen. The Uzumaki boy should be trained properly. Root has the facilities.
captions.speaker: DANZO

captions.text: No. Absolutely not.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: You've given the Nine-Tails a library card. A child with that much access is a risk.
captions.speaker: DANZO

captions.text: He has a staff form, actually.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: A form is paper. I'll requisition him through the council. Today.
captions.speaker: DANZO

captions.text: Section three of the staff regulations.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Office staff answer to the Hokage and no one else. Not the council. Not Root. Not you.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: I signed it twice by accident! Does that make it twice as binding?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I believe it does.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Also, one of your guys sat on a filing box last night.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It was me. I'd like an apology.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I don't know what you mean.
captions.speaker: DANZO

captions.text: Plain mask. Boots like a wet sandwich. Sat on me for an hour.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He's a boy, Hiruzen.
captions.speaker: DANZO

captions.text: He's my clerk.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Danzo has a hundred ways around a rule. He has none around a form.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Weeks ago, the Third Hokage filed the one document in Konoha that Root can't requisition. The old man didn't punish him. He hired him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He'll try again, Naruto.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: I know. He'll have to fill out a form.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I'm very proud of that form.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Danzo leaves without raising his voice. He doesn't look angry.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He looks like a man who has simply moved the appointment.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Third Hokage has an idea. Keep Team Seven busy and inside the village.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: So he hands them D-ranks. Weeding. Painting. Babysitting. And the occasional lost cat.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto sends two hundred clones. By noon, twelve missions are done. By three, twenty-nine.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Every garden in Konoha has been weeded by someone with the same face.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He hasn't gotten one ounce stronger. He has simply brought more of himself.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Years from now he'll run the whole Hokage's office this way. Today it's the mission board.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Eleven of the forty missions are the same cat.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Tora, the Daimyo's wife's cat, escapes every week, and every week a team loses an afternoon and some skin.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss, found the cat. Again.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Again? What number is this?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Eleven. We know his hiding places better than he does.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: By the eleventh capture, the cat has given up.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Daimyo's wife squeezes it until its eyes go dead, and for once the whole room agrees with the cat.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Weeding, done. Painting, done. Grocery run for the Akimichi clan, done.
captions.speaker: IRUKA

captions.text: That one was hard. They noticed we ate the potato chips.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Naruto. I notice the missions are finished before I find out what they are.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Efficiency, sensei!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I've read four chapters. Don't stop on my account.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Team Seven. Forty D-ranks. In one day. That's the entire board.
captions.speaker: IRUKA

captions.text: I can't feel my arms.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Tch. Is that all there is?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: I'm up to chapter nine. Excellent day.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: There are no more D-ranks. I'm out. I looked under the desk.
captions.speaker: IRUKA

captions.text: Then I suppose it's time for something harder. A C-rank. An escort.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Who's the client, old man?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: A bridge builder from the Land of Waves. He's paying the going rate for a C-rank.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Finally.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: That night in the archive, Naruto reads the part of the bingo book nobody reads. The appendix.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Hidden Mist's procedure for hunting their own missing ninja. It's written like a recipe.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Step one, find the missing-nin. Step two, finish the missing-nin.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Step three, destroy the body where it falls.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: There's a diagram. A body, a flame, and an arrow that says, here.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Why where it falls?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Secrets. A hunter never carries the body home.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: It says so four times. Underlined twice.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: And somebody wrote in the margin, I mean it.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: So they burn it right there. Nobody drags a body forty miles. I respect that.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It's the most boring paragraph in the book. Naruto folds the corner of the page anyway.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boring paragraphs are where the useful things hide.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The next morning, at the village gate.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Team Seven, one jonin, and a bridge builder from the Land of Waves, with a hat, a bottle and a very calm face.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: I'm just a simple bridge builder.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Nothing exciting is going to happen on this trip. I promise.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: That's what a C-rank is, right? Nothing exciting?
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Stay close. It's an escort. Nothing dangerous. Probably.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: They walk out under the gate. For the first hour Naruto is quiet, which worries Kakashi more than any noise could.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Behind them, a hundred clones hold the archive. Ahead, a long dry road.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Dust. Cracked mud. Not a cloud since last week.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And in the middle of the road, sitting there as if somebody left it behind, is a puddle.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sensei. It hasn't rained in a week.
captions.speaker: NARUTO
